description: Create an empty organization skill, before publishing to it. Use it, then publish_skill, when the user wants to share a skill with their team, such as one they keep locally: every member's agent then finds it through list_skills. This is the first step for a new skill: publish_skill and create_push change a skill that exists and refuse a name that does not. Its repository starts from a starter SKILL.md, or, for a well-known name such as governance or design-system, from Valet's default, so a clone or a push begins from that text. Nothing is published until publish_skill runs: agents and list_skills see no version yet. A name the organization's own skill already holds is refused. With catalog, it instead installs that skill from Valet's curated catalog: the organization gets its own copy, published as v1, that changes only when the organization publishes it. An organization that installed it before gets its copy back unchanged. Requires connecting a Valet account.

catalog.description: The name of a catalog skill to install, such as premortem. Omit to create an empty skill.

idempotency_key.description: An opaque key of your choosing. Repeating a call with the same key returns the first call's result instead of refusing the name the first call took, which makes a retry safe.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to create it in. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

skill.description: The skill's name: lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens, at most 64 characters. Required unless catalog is given, when it defaults to the catalog skill's name and must equal it.

name: create_skill
title: Create an organization skill
